item.g:title: Jean Paul Gaultier Marbled Jeans Women Blue – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: Vintage jeans by Jean Paul Gaultier from the Gaultier Jean's line in washed blue. The defining feature is the distinctive denim wash with an uneven, marbled colour effect and visible patina. The silhouette sits close to the body at hip and thigh and continues into a straighter, slightly flared leg. At the back, the low-set pockets, the V-shaped yoke and the metallic Gaultier Jean's Paris logo shape the look. It fastens classically with a button fly of several embossed metal buttons. Inside, the typical Gaultier Jean's logo tape runs along the waistband. A characteristic vintage denim piece with a clearly recognisable Jean Paul Gaultier design approach.

item.g:title: Prada Cap Black – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: Simple, functional Prada Cap in deep black with a technical look. The material looks light and smooth, with a subtle, almost industrial surface that is typical of Prada's utilitarian design language. The clear silhouette is supported by the precisely shaped brim and the reduced lines. Side-set metal eyelets as well as the red Prada detail set specific accents and subtly break the monochrome calm. The adjustable back ensures flexible adjustment, while the overall minimalist construction makes the cap versatile – between sporty functionality and urban archive character.

item.g:title: Jil Sander Sweet Angel Reversible Top Women Black – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: An early Jil Sander piece from the early 2000s, characterized by a reduced, almost raw interpretation of graphics and silhouette. On the one hand, the top shows the "Sweet Angel" print in restrained tonality, on the other hand a contrasting, clear version with "Fly High" motif. The reversible construction gives the piece a double reading between subtle and present. The cut is deliberately simple, slightly shortened with open, raw-looking sleeves and side slits, creating an informal, almost deconstructive effect. The soft cotton jersey falls loose and adapts to the body without rigid shape. For a piece from this time remarkably well preserved and in a condition that underlines the longevity of the early Jil Sander production.

item.g:title: Rick Owens DRKSHDW Long Sleeve Unisex Khaki – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: A reduced longsleeve from the DRKSHDW context by Rick Owens, characterized by clear lines and subtle construction work. The cut is slightly extended with narrow-lined sleeves and a quiet, flowing silhouette. The characteristic seam guide in the shoulder and back area as well as the minimal detail on the neckline underline the typical, restrained and deconstructive signature of the line. The material looks soft, light and close to the body, with a matt finish in covered taupe, which can be integrated into monochrome as well as structured looks. An essential piece with precise effect and high everyday suitability.

item.g:title: Prada Bomber Jacket Women Black – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: A reduced, precisely interpreted bomber silhouette from Prada. The shortened length gives the classic design a modern, clear line, while the technical fabric creates a smooth, slightly structured surface with subtle tension. The zipper in the front is framed by a narrow stand-up collar with contrasting stripes that gives the piece a sporty architectural touch. The narrow fit follows the body line without narrowing down and is defined by elastic hem and sleeves. A discreet chest pocket complements the minimalist design and underlines the functional character of this precisely designed piece.
item.g:google_product_category: Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Outerwear > Coats & Jackets

item.g:title: Moose Knuckles Parka with Leather Details Men Black – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: A striking technical jacket by Moose Knuckles, designed in deep black with a clearly structured silhouette. The model combines a robust, matte outer surface with targeted leather details on shoulders, pockets and sleeves, which give the piece a precise, almost architectural effect. Metallic rivets and hardware set functional accents and underline the industrial character. The high stand-up collar with full zip ensures protection and shape stability, while the extended fit creates a clear, modern line. Inside, a high-contrast graphic lining is displayed, which adds visual depth to the otherwise reduced exterior.
item.g:google_product_category: Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Outerwear > Coats & Jackets

item.g:title: Just Cavalli Jacket Women Black – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: A precisely cut silhouette meets a clear, almost sculptural line. This Just Cavalli jacket stands out for its fitted shape, which wraps the body in a structured way and creates an elegant, slightly flared line at the bottom. The textile outer fabric has a fine, lightly textured surface that adds depth and character without being loud. The fur-look trims at the collar, sleeves and hem are striking and give the otherwise reduced design a subtle, expressive note. The full-length front zip underlines the clean, modern look and keeps the front calm and linear. A balance of classic tailoring and decorative accents.

item.g:title: Jean Paul Gaultier Leather Jacket Women Rosé – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: This waisted-cut leather jacket by Jean Paul Gaultier shows a precise, close-to-body silhouette with feminine lines. The soft leather in a muted rosé tone has a slightly changing surface that gives the material depth and character. The narrow waistline is accentuated by shaping seams, while the slightly flared hem in the back creates a subtle peplum effect. The shoulder part is gently accentuated, creating a clear, structured line. Classic lapels and a reduced two-button placket complement the design and underline the calm, elegant expression. The sleeves are slim and slightly flared, which harmoniously rounds off the overall shape.

item.g:title: Jil Sander Blazer Women Black – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: A reduced blazer by Jil Sander in deep black, characterized by clear lines and restrained precision. The silhouette is slim cut, with subtle waisting and classic lapel, creating a calm, controlled shape. The smooth surface looks structured and yet soft, allowing the blazer to be worn both in a formal context and in a broken, modern styling. The design follows the typical Jil Sander approach: functional, puristic and without superfluous elements.

item.g:title: Jean Paul Gaultier Soleil Mesh Top Women White – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: A lightweight, translucent dress from the Jean Paul Gaultier Soleil line, made of fine mesh fabric with flowing, almost floating material effect. The silhouette is deliberately held loose, with wide neckline and gently falling sleeves that create a relaxed, almost weightless presence. Characteristic are the subtle but concise embroidery on the sleeves, which absorb organic, feather-like motifs and give the piece a subtle visual tension. The drawstring at the neckline sets a functional as well as design accent and underlines the experimental approach of the Soleil line. The transparent structure allows versatile layering options and positions the dress clearly in the avant-garde context of the brand.

item.g:title: Jean Paul Gaultier Soleil Mesh Top Women Black – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: A light, translucent top from the iconic Soleil line by Jean Paul Gaultier, which convinces with its characteristic materiality and subtle staging of transparency. The fine, flowing fabric lies softly over the silhouette and creates a reduced, almost floating effect. The design is accented by the striking lacing in the chest area with multi-coloured cords in warm tones, which give the piece an organic, almost artisanal touch. The loosely cut sleeves end in graphically elaborated details, reminiscent of abstracted sunbeams and take up the visual language of the Soleil collection. A piece that balances between lightness and expression and carries itself both as a layering element and as an independent statement.

item.g:title: Jean Paul Gaultier Maille Floral Dress Women Multicolour – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: A light, close-to-body dress from the Maille line by Jean Paul Gaultier, characterized by a dense, floral composition in intense red, green and cream tones. The silhouette is narrow and flowing, with fine straps and a softly crafted neckline accented by organic ruffle ends. The material shows the typical, elastic transparency of the Gaultier Maille, whereby the dress adapts to the body and creates a subtle depth in the print. The focus is on an artful, collage-like representation that combines floral elements with figurative imagery and gives the piece a clear visual identity. The workmanship remains deliberately light and flexible, which allows the dress to be worn individually as well as in layering.

item.g:title: Isaac Sellam Experience Trousers Women White – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: This Isaac Sellam Experience pants shows the label's raw, experimental aesthetics in a very characteristic shape. The loose silhouette meets a grey-white, marbled wash, striking seams and typical metallic details. The deliberately irregular used/distressed look belongs to the design and gives the piece a strong avant-garde presence.

item.g:title: Gucci Pinstripe Blazer Women Black – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: Narrow-cut Gucci Blazer in deep black with fine pinstripe pattern. The silhouette is close to the body, with clearly structured shoulder area, classic lapel and a single front button. The vertical stripe guide visually lengthens the shape and gives the blazer a precise, elegant line. Two discreet flap pockets at the front and the slightly rounded hem underline the classic tailoring character. The inside of the blazer is completely lined, with Gucci label and size indication 40. A restrained designer piece with a calm presence, suitable for simple trousers, denim or as a contrast to avant-garde layers.

item.g:title: Dsquared2 Surf Camp Jacket Men Yellow – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: Lightweight jacket of Dsquared2 in striking yellow with a sporty, slightly shortened cut. The clear silhouette is defined by precisely set seams and a continuous front zipper. Characteristic is the contrasting grey hood area, which gives the piece a hybrid mix of utility and casual. On the chest, a graphic patch with illustrative motif sets a visual focus and underlines the playful yet controlled design design language of the brand. The elastic cuffs at the hem ensure a structured fit, while the material offers a light, movable portability.

item.g:title: Dsquared2 Asymmetric Biker Jacket Men Brown – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: This asymmetrical moto jacket by Dsquared2 comes from an early collection of the 2000s and combines functional workwear elements with a clear, avant-garde lines. The distinctive, diagonal front zipper defines the silhouette and creates a tensioning, slightly offset front view. The sturdy cotton material shows a slightly waxed, matte surface with subtle patina, which gives the piece depth and character. The shade moves between deep brown and almost black nuance and has a different intensity depending on the light. Classic details such as patch pockets, snaps and structured seams are reinterpreted by the unconventional construction. The jacket sits close to the body with clearly guided shoulders and a straight, slightly shortened line, which makes it both functional and stylistically versatile.

item.g:title: Balenciaga SNCF Vest Women Black – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: A reduced, functional piece from a rare collaboration: Balenciaga originally designed this vest for SNCF, the state-owned French railway company. The designs were created in the context of workwear with increased demands for functionality, visibility and clear lines. The black wool structure is broken by a precisely set red piping along the front and the neckline. The silhouette is slightly boxy, with an open arm base and a quiet, technical look. The button placket fits seamlessly into the overall picture and underlines the utilitarian origin. Portable as a stand-alone piece as well as in the layering context.

item.g:title: Prada Jacket Women Light Blue – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: A minimalist, technically-looking jacket by Prada in a quiet, bright blue. The clean construction with concealed front strip and additional zipper creates a clear, reduced silhouette, while the slightly structured fabric creates a subtle tension between function and elegance. The high stand-up collar emphasizes the vertical line and gives the piece an almost uniform rigour. Elastic cuffs on the sleeves ensure a controlled shape, while the side pockets are discreetly integrated. A fine, typical Prada detail is shown on the sleeve in the form of a red accent, which is deliberately restrained. The jacket looks lightweight, precise and versatile to wear, both as a transition piece and as a functional layering component.

item.g:title: Prada Jacket in Crinkle Look Women Black – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: This Prada jacket is characterized by an unusual, avant-garde material structure with a deliberately twitched surface. The fabric looks light and technical, while the irregular texture gives the garment a characteristic, almost sculptural surface. The silhouette is short cut and slightly cascading, creating a modern, architectural look. A hood complements the reduced design and underlines the functional character of the design. The frontal zipper as well as the clearly integrated pockets are unobtrusively integrated into the minimalist design. The dark, slightly changing color effect enhances the plastic effect of the material and makes the piece a striking addition to experimental or minimalist wardrobes.

item.g:title: Helmut Lang Striped Shirt Men Light Blue – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: Minimalist shirt by Helmut Lang with fine vertical stripes in dark blue on white background. The silhouette is loosely cut with slightly falling shoulder line, which gives the shirt a modern, relaxed fit. Black buttons set a clear contrast to the light fabric base. A classic chest pocket as well as discreet Helmut-Lang lettering on the front and back underline the reduced urban character of the design. Lightweight cotton fabric with a clear structure, ideal as a stand-alone piece or layering.

item.g:title: Dior Long-Sleeve Polo Shirt Men Black – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: A classic dior polo shirt in dark black with long sleeves and subtle, clear lines. The model is made of structured piqué cotton and has a reduced silhouette that is typical of the brand's minimalist aesthetics. The narrow button placket with two buttons and the fine ribbed collar with contrasting stripes give the piece a subtle sporty elegance. On the chest there is a small, tonal dior embroidery that deliberately keeps the design restrained. The polo looks timeless and versatile to wear – both as an elegant basic under a jacket and as an independent statement in a reduced wardrobe.

item.g:title: Dior Long-Sleeve Polo Shirt Men Navy – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: A classic dior polo with long sleeves in a deep dark navy tone. The upper shows the typical piqué structure, which gives the fabric a slightly grainy surface and a stable shape. The narrow collar is accented with fine stripe details and leads into a short button placket with discreetly branded buttons. On the left chest there is a small, tonal dior bee motif that gives the piece a subtle signature. The silhouette looks slim and modern, while at the same time the polo remains versatile – both combined in sport and as a minimalist designer basic in everyday life.

item.g:title: Yves Saint Laurent Rive Gauche Silk Top Women Multicolour – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: A graphically embossed archive piece from the Yves Saint Laurent Rive Gauche line with a characteristic colour play of red, orange, violet and brown. The vivid print is reminiscent of expressive brush strokes and creates a dynamic surface. The light silk fabric falls soft and ensures a flowing silhouette. The sleeveless cut with frontal button placket gives the top a clear, slightly flared shape. In combination with the striking pattern, a piece with a strong visual presence is created that can be worn individually as well as used in modern layering looks.

item.g:title: Isaac Sellam Leather Blazer Women Grey – Pre-Owned
item.g:description: Finely crafted leather blazer by Isaac Sellam in a cool grey-green with a matte, slightly washed surface. The shade moves between sage and stone, looks restrained and at the same time self-contained. The silhouette is waisted and clearly follows the body line. Precisely set seams structure the front and back and give the model an architectural calm. The lapel is classic, the front is closed by three buttons in warm brown tone. Patch pockets and long sleeves with distinctive button placket on the cuffs underline the craftsmanship. Back slits ensure freedom of movement and a balanced proportion. The leather shows a natural structure with subtle patina.

Wearable over trousers, skirts or styled directly on the body, this piece stands as an example for Gaultier's playful handling of function, body and fashion as a construction.
